benefits.subtitle: Less admin, less chasing, and a simpler way to compare your options.

items.title: No repeated outreach
items.desc: You do not have to search for five service providers and send five separate quote requests. GruntWrk handles that in one flow.

items.title: Choose service providers with confidence
items.desc: See ratings, reviews, and service provider details before you decide who should quote on your request.

items.title: One place to compare
items.desc: Quotes land inside the same workbench card, then the selection stage helps you compare and appoint the right service provider.

fees.heading: Why your quotes are lower on GruntWrk
fees.subtitle: Customers use GruntWrk completely free. Service providers pay a simple 10% job fee only when work moves ahead. No lead fees, no credit packs, no subscriptions. Service providers keep more and customers pay less.
fees.note: Based on public pricing and help-center pages reviewed on March 16, 2026. Fees vary by service and market.

rows.marketSummary: Some marketplaces charge a one-time onboarding fee before you can start taking work.
Pay to unlock customer details or spend money each time you want to pursue a job.
Prepay for credits or contact packs before you can quote on requests.
Pay extra to appear higher in search or unlock more exposure for your profile.
Monthly platform access or plan fees just to stay listed and compete for work.
Charged when a customer shortlists you or shows a stronger signal of intent.
Extra payment-related charges layered on top of other marketplace fees.
A portion of funds can be retained on-platform before payout is released.
A single transaction fee when the booking and payment are completed through the platform.

howItWorks.heading: How GruntWrk works
howItWorks.subtitle: From one request to multiple quotes in three steps

steps.title: Describe the job
steps.body: Specify what you need, where it is, and your target budget in one guided request.

steps.title: Pick service providers
steps.body: Pick who you want to quote after seeing ratings, reviews, and service provider details in the directory.

steps.title: Compare quotes
steps.body: Every quote flows into one job card so you can compare, score, and appoint the best fit in one place.

workbench.title: Everything lands in one quote workbench.

points.title: See every quote together
points.desc: Each selected service provider replies into the same job card so you can compare price, timing, and fit without scattered emails.

points.title: Choose with more confidence
points.desc: Selection mode scores service providers against the request so you can shortlist intelligently instead of guessing.

points.title: Keep the whole request together
points.desc: Your brief, photos, messages, and quote updates stay in one place from first request to final choice.

points.title: Move forward with the winner
points.desc: Once you choose a service provider, the job continues through the existing GruntWrk workflow without starting over.
